results.title: Zygote
results.overview: Years after an apocalyptic event wiped out most of the Earth’s population, a lone wanderer carrying the salvation of mankind meets a mysterious stranger.

results.title: MIDASKOMPLEX
results.overview: Two young friends, looking forward to going out to party, rob a corrupt milk company and subsequently have to fight for their lives, but also for the preservation of their friendship

results.title: El Lambo de San Blas
results.overview: Dani, a poor 15-year-old boy, hates women, loves the gym and cryptocurrencies, and, despite his family, idolizes Leonidas, a controversial social media guru who constantly promises methods to become a millionaire, win over the girl of your dreams, and, most importantly, get out of San Blas.

results.title: The Stillness
results.overview: A lone survivor of the Mortuus Strain outbreak scavenges his new reality, narrowly escaping the infected casualties still walking the earth.

results.title: Amalnama
results.overview: Hasan has left behind his dark past to lead a happy family life with his wife and two daughters. One night, posing as law enforcement officers, a group abruptly takes him from his home, casting a shroud of dreadful uncertainty over the entire family.

results.title: Marlee Matlin: Not Alone Anymore
results.overview: In 1987, Marlee Matlin became the first Deaf actor to win an Academy Award and was thrust into the spotlight at 21 years old. Reflecting on her life in her primary language of American Sign Language, Marlee explores the complexities of what it means to be a trailblazer.

results.title: The Cowgirl, the Showgirl and the Pig
results.original_title: A Vaqueira, a Dançarina e o Porco
results.overview: "The Cowgirl, the Showgirl and the Pig" is a short film directed by Stella Carneiro and Ary Zara. It premiered in Directors' Fortnight of the 78th Cannes Film Festival as part of the La Factory des Cineastes program.

results.title: Masha and the Bears
results.overview: Masha has to save her brother, who fell under the spell of the forest's evil spirits and turned into a goat. To break the terrible curse, the girl has to join forces with the fairy tale heroes she has known since childhood—the three bears.

results.title: O Doce Sal dos Seus Fadigosos Lábios
results.original_title: O Doce Sal dos Seus Fadigosos Lábios

results.title: Liwaliw
results.overview: A couple's weekend escape is shattered by a shocking intrusion, uncovering hidden desires and betrayal. When love and rage collide, how far will they go to survive the truth?

results.title: Lilly
results.overview: Based on the inspiring true story of Lilly Ledbetter, an ordinary Alabama tire factory supervisor who discovers she's being paid less than her male peers. Her fight for fair pay takes her to the Supreme Court and Congress, while powerful forces try to shut her down. Lilly refuses to accept the status quo and has the courage to fight for what is right.

results.title: The Birds
results.overview: A moving portrait of one man's desperation to decipher the relationship between mass-murmurations of seabirds and a single super-speed predator.

results.title: Outed
results.overview: An overbearing mother implores her horny son to resist his urges to save him from the fate she endured.

results.title: Mary Christmas
results.overview: Jack hires a live-in nanny, 'Mary', to help look after his daughter during the holidays. She brings festive cheer and magic into their home, bringing him closer to his child and ultimately making him fall head over heels in love with her.

results.title: Tip$
results.overview: Struggling to make ends meet in their day-to-day life, five young men decide to take to the stage to get their finances to align with their needs.

results.title: Bromance
results.overview: Binto teams up with his brother's friends for a thrilling adventure to find him, leading to unexpected twists, discoveries, and unforgettable moments.

results.title: Kalamkaval
results.overview: Early 2010s. A routine Kerala Police inquiry in the quiet village of Kottayikonam takes an unexpected turn when a trail of seemingly minor clues unravels into a string of disturbing cases. The investigation soon crosses into Tamil Nadu, revealing unsolved mysteries that have lingered for years.
